'''Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India, Pvt. Ltd.''', abbreviated as '''HMSI''', is the wholly owned Indian subsidiary of [[Honda]], [[Japan]].<ref name="About">[https://www.honda2wheelersindia.com/aboutus/default.asp HMSI --> About Us] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070804111602/http://www.honda2wheelersindia.com/aboutus/default.asp |date=2007-08-04 }}</ref> Founded in 1999,<ref name="About" /> it was the fourth Honda automotive venture in India, after [[Kinetic Honda]] Motor Ltd (1984–1998), [[Hero MotoCorp|Hero Honda]] (1984–2011) and [[Honda Cars India|Honda Siel Cars India]] (1995–2012).<ref name="GroupCompanies">[https://www.honda2wheelersindia.com/aboutus/groupcompanies.asp HMSI --> About Us --> The Group Companies] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070813213945/http://www.honda2wheelersindia.com/aboutus/groupcompanies.asp |date=2007-08-13 }}</ref> HMSI was established in 1999 at [[Manesar]], [[Gurgaon district|Gurugram]], Haryana.

==Manufacturing Plants==
Total capacity  = 7.05 million units per annum<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.autocarpro.in/news-national/honda-2wheelers-indias-third-scooter-assembly-line-at-gujarat-plant-goes-on-stream-118570|title=Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India}}</ref>
*Plant 1: [[Manesar]], [[Gurgaon district|Gurugram]]  ([[Haryana]]) - 1.6 million units
*Plant 2: Tapukara, [[Alwar district|Alwar]] (Rajasthan) - 1.2 million units
*Plant 3: Narsapura, [[Kolar district|Kolar]] (Karnataka) - 2.4 million units
*Plant 4: Vitthalapur, [[Ahmedabad district|Ahmedabad]] (Gujarat) - 1.85 million units

HMSI got ISO 14001 certification in December 2002. HMSI plans to use the [[PDCA]] cycle for its environmental management system.<ref name="Environment">[http://www.honda2wheelersindia.com/hondawindow/environment.asp HMSI --> Honda Window --> Environment] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070813213852/http://www.honda2wheelersindia.com/hondawindow/environment.asp |date=2007-08-13 }}</ref>
